title: Updates
unavailable: Valve Oil's update status isn't available on this printer.
reconnecting: Waiting for the printer to answer. It restarts its services while it updates, so this is expected. This page reconnects by itself.
reconnecting_long_one: The printer hasn't answered for {{count}} minute. Don't turn it off. Check its screen to see what it's doing.
reconnecting_long_other: The printer hasn't answered for {{count}} minutes. Don't turn it off. Check its screen to see what it's doing.
dont_power_off: Don't turn the printer off until it finishes.

card.target_firmware: This Valve Oil release updates it to {{version}}
card.auto_sub: Install new Valve Oil releases, QIDI firmware, and board firmware by themselves while the printer is idle.
card.check_failed: The last check for updates failed.
card.check_failed_message: The last check for updates failed: {{message}}
card.report_sub: Opens a bug report on GitHub and downloads a support bundle with Klipper's, Moonraker's, and Valve Oil's logs. Attach the bundle to the issue.
card.support_error: The support bundle couldn't be downloaded: {{error}}

window.title: Update window
window.hours: Automatic updates start only between these hours.
window.any_hour: Automatic updates can start at any hour.

timezone.lookup: Times are in {{timezone}} (found from the printer's internet address).
timezone.browser: Times are in {{timezone}} (set from a browser).

window.invalid: Pick a different start and end hour.
window.error: The update window couldn't be changed: {{error}}

waiting.reinstall: Valve Oil needs to be installed again (its files on the printer are missing or changed)

notice.auto_off: An update is waiting. Automatic updates are off, so install it with Update now or by running the Valve Oil installer.
notice.auto_off_reinstall: Valve Oil needs to be installed again. Automatic updates are off, so install it with Update now or by running the Valve Oil installer.
notice.blocked: Automatic updates are on, but the update hasn't been installed yet: {{reasons}}.
notice.blocked_reinstall: Automatic updates are on, but Valve Oil hasn't been installed again yet: {{reasons}}.
notice.window: Automatic updates are on, so the update will be installed during the update window, {{window}}, while the printer is idle.
notice.window_reinstall: Automatic updates are on, so Valve Oil will be installed again during the update window, {{window}}, while the printer is idle.
notice.next_check: Automatic updates are on, so the update will be installed at the next update check while the printer is idle.
notice.next_check_at: Automatic updates are on, so the update will be installed at the next update check, around {{time}}, while the printer is idle.
notice.next_check_reinstall: Automatic updates are on, so Valve Oil will be installed again at the next update check while the printer is idle.
notice.next_check_reinstall_at: Automatic updates are on, so Valve Oil will be installed again at the next update check, around {{time}}, while the printer is idle.
notice.firmware_busy: The printer can't be used while it installs.

confirm.continue: Continue the QIDI firmware update that stopped? The printer can't be used until the update finishes, which can take a while, and this page loses contact with the printer for part of that time. Don't turn the printer off until the update finishes.
confirm.finish: Finish the update that stopped? The printer can't be used until it finishes, which can take a while, and this page loses contact with the printer for part of that time. Don't turn the printer off until the update finishes.
confirm.firmware: Install everything that's waiting now, including QIDI firmware and board firmware? The printer can't be used until the update finishes, which can take a while, and this page loses contact with the printer for part of that time. Don't turn the printer off until the update finishes.
confirm.reinstall: Install Valve Oil {{version}} again now? Its files on the printer are missing or changed. Klipper restarts while it installs, so the printer can't be used for a few minutes.
confirm.install_version: Install Valve Oil {{version}} now? Klipper restarts while it installs, so the printer can't be used for a few minutes.
confirm.install_latest: Install the latest Valve Oil release now? Klipper restarts while it installs, so the printer can't be used for a few minutes.

code.run_in_progress: Available once the running update finishes.
code.installer_busy: Valve Oil is checking for updates or installing. Available once it finishes.
code.printing: A print is running or paused. Available once it finishes.
code.heaters_on: A heater is on. Available once every heater is off.
code.printer_state_unknown: Klipper hasn't said whether the printer is idle. Available once it's ready.
code.installer_missing: Valve Oil's installer is missing from the printer. Install Valve Oil again to use Update now.

running.install: The Valve Oil installer is running…

interrupted.update_now: The update stopped before it finished
interrupted.automatic: The automatic update stopped before it finished
interrupted.install: The Valve Oil installer stopped before it finished
interrupted.other: The update stopped before it finished

progress.resumed: Picking up where the last attempt stopped.
progress.firmware_failed: The QIDI firmware update didn't finish
progress.finish_hint: Finish it with Update now or by running the Valve Oil installer.
progress.continue_hint: Continue it with Update now or by running the Valve Oil installer.

note.unrecognized_bootloader: Valve Oil doesn't recognize this board's bootloader yet, so it doesn't update this board or the printer's QIDI firmware. Open a support issue so a later release can support it.
note.unrecognized_bootloader_box: Valve Oil doesn't recognize this Box's bootloader yet, so it leaves this Box as it is and keeps updating the rest of the printer. Open a support issue so a later release can support it.
note.unrecognized_firmware: This board runs firmware Valve Oil doesn't recognize, so Valve Oil leaves it as it is. Open a support issue so a later release can support it.
note.unknown: Valve Oil hasn't been able to read this board's firmware yet.
note.held_box: This Box was put back on QIDI's firmware. Valve Oil leaves it there until you install the next Valve Oil release.
note.held_closed_loop: Valve Oil left the closed-loop motor drivers on their firmware. Update them from the touchscreen's firmware page.
note.held: Valve Oil leaves this board's firmware as it is.
note.after_firmware: Valve Oil updates this board in the same update, right after it installs the QIDI firmware update.
note.after_firmware_version: Valve Oil updates this board in the same update, right after it installs QIDI firmware {{version}}.

support.title: Open a support issue for {{name}}
support.step_open: Open the issue. The form comes with this printer, its QIDI firmware, and {{name}}'s report filled in.
support.step_origin: Say how {{name}} got its firmware: it came with the printer, you bought it on its own, or QIDI sent it as a replacement.
support.step_report: If the form's report says it was too long for the link, download the report and attach it.

origin.firmware_update: Continuing after the QIDI firmware update

install.interrupted_title: The install stopped before it finished
install.dont_turn_off: Don't turn the printer off. Klipper and Moonraker restart during the install, so this page may lose contact for a moment.
install.interrupted_body: The installer stopped running partway, for example because its SSH session closed. Run the installer again to finish.
install.failed_body: Its log says what went wrong and what state the printer was left in.

logs.title: Installer logs
logs.none: No installer logs yet. Each install, update, uninstall, and backup restore saves one here.
logs.kept: The installer keeps its newest ten logs. Attach the one that went wrong when you report a problem.
logs.last_handed_off: Last install{{how}}{{at}} went on in the QIDI firmware update.

status.printing: a print is running or paused
